excerpts.text: TEMPE, Ariz., March 1, 2022 -- fourth quarter and full year 2021 financial results.

Net Sales $2.4B to $2.6B; Earnings per Diluted Share $0.00 to $0.60; Gross Profit $155M to $215M including $10-15 million of underutilization losses; Capital Expenditures $850M to $1.1B; Shipments 8.9GW to 9.4GW; Net Cash Balance $1.1B to $1.35B.

sources.title: First Solar, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2021 (accession 0001274494-22-000009)
sources.availability_basis: EDGAR acceptance, filed 2022-03-01 (same day as the earnings 8-K)

excerpts.text: World's largest thin film PV solar module manufacturer and the largest PV solar module manufacturer in the Western Hemisphere; over 40 GW DC of modules sold globally.

Modules Business reportable segment; Other segment includes residual project development and O&M services, primarily Japan, planned for sale in the first half of 2022; modules represented approximately 80% of 2021 net sales on a third-party basis.
The United States accounted for 84% of our 2021 net sales.
Third U.S. manufacturing facility (3.3 GW DC), expected first half of 2023; first India facility (3.3 GW DC), expected second half of 2023.
India announced import duty tariffs of 40% on solar modules and 25% on solar cells beginning in April 2022.
Proposed measures to incentivize domestic manufacturing with tax credits and domestic content, labor and wage requirements; unclear whether and to what extent such measures will be enacted.
Funded our module manufacturing and capacity expansion initiatives primarily using cash flows generated by our operations; no dividend or share-repurchase commitment stated.

claims.text: The company designs and manufactures thin-film cadmium telluride solar photovoltaic modules, selling primarily to utility-scale solar project developers worldwide.
Full-year 2021 net sales were $2,923.4 million, up 7.8% from $2,711.3 million in 2020.
Q4 2021 net sales were $907.3 million versus $609.2 million in Q4 2020.
Full-year 2021 diluted EPS was $4.38 and Q4 2021 diluted EPS was $1.23.
The $4.38 FY2021 diluted EPS actually reported sits above the midpoint ($4.30) of the $4.00-$4.60 guidance range issued 2021-11-04 and within the original $4.05-$4.75 range issued 2021-02-25.
claims.formula: midpoint = (low+high)/2 of the 2021-11-04 guidance range; comparison of actual EPS to both guidance ranges

claims.text: 2022 guidance: net sales $2.4-$2.6 billion; diluted EPS $0.00-$0.60; gross profit $155-$215 million including $10-15 million of underutilization losses; capital expenditures $850 million-$1.1 billion; shipments 8.9-9.4 GW-DC; year-end net cash balance $1.1-$1.35 billion.
2021 net bookings were 17.5 GW-DC, including 11.8 GW-DC booked since the Q3 2021 earnings call.
The company's Japan-based project development and operations-and-maintenance business is planned for sale in the first half of 2022.

First Solar describes itself as the world's largest thin-film PV module manufacturer and the largest PV module manufacturer in the Western Hemisphere, with more than 40 GW-DC of modules sold, using cadmium telluride technology with cited advantages in heat/humidity response, cracking resistance, energy payback time and carbon/water footprint versus crystalline silicon.

Planned capacity additions: a third U.S. manufacturing facility (3.3 GW-DC) targeted for the first half of 2023, and a first India manufacturing facility (3.3 GW-DC) targeted for the second half of 2023.
The United States accounted for 84% of 2021 net sales.
India introduced import tariffs of 40% on solar modules and 25% on solar cells effective April 2022, alongside domestic-manufacturer preferences for government-linked procurement.

The 10-K's business/capital-allocation discussion states the company funds manufacturing and capacity expansion primarily from operating cash flow and does not mention a dividend or share-buyback program.
Actual 2021 capital expenditures of $540.3 million came in below the most recently guided (2021-11-04) range of $675-725 million.
claims.formula: comparison of XBRL PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment FY2021 actual to the 2021-11-04 guided range

claims.text: First Solar reported a full-year net loss of $114.9 million and diluted EPS of -$1.09 in FY2019, before returning to profitability in FY2020 and FY2021.

Proposed U.S. federal legislation to incentivize domestic solar manufacturing (tax credits, domestic content/labor/wage requirements) was under discussion as of the filing date; the company stated it was unclear whether and to what extent such measures would be enacted.
